next_step: closed-lost; schedule re-engage Q3 2026 if budget opens
closing_reason: Selected Together for an on-prem installer + faster security evaluation; pricing + lack of exec sponsor at Prism caused lost deal.
notes: Summary: POC for customer Q&A + personalization pipeline. Heavy emphasis on private deployment and auditability.
POC scope: semantic search (embeddings), short-form chat assistant (200ms p95 latency target), reranking for product suggestions.
Security: legal + infosec requested SAML SSO, audit logs retention, and EU residency for subset of data. Redwood answered SOC2 + KMS integration but on-prem checklist had gaps per their infra team.
Pricing: Prism expected committed ARR in 6 figures. Replicate appeared cheaper for burst inference; Together pitched an on-prem appliance which Prism preferred.
Quote from Head of ML (A. Rivera): "The Together on-prem bundle lets us keep models behind our firewall and gave our security team more comfort."
Champion: initially strong engagement from ML engineering (Eva) but product leadership budget approval stalled. No executive sponsor surfaced during procurement.
Deal dynamics: Prism ran two-week POC (Dec 2025) — measured latency and cost. Redwood performed two on-site calls with infra; responded to security questionnaire (see drive link).
Why lost: final security signoff flagged need for air-gapped installer; Together committed a private appliance roadmap. Pricing negotiation also tightened after Q4 budget freeze.
Action items noted: keep technical runbook, offer slimmed-down appliance checklist for next re-engage; reach back after their fiscal refresh (Q3 2026).
